About:

Meet Gucci | Apply Now | $150 Adoption Fee | Fully Sponsored Training

It’s all Gucciiiiii

No really, meet Gucci! He’s an 8 year old, 65lb terrier mix we pulled from a shelter out in Long Island earlier this summer. This absolute goon has been upstate working on some manners and is now ready to find his happily ever after.

If you’ve ever wanted a dog that will lay on you with all of his weight any and every chance he gets, Gucci is for you. He is playful and enjoys an adventure from time to time, but ultimately would rather be at home on the couch. The Gooch is a top notch cuddler, and you can say goodbye to your weighted blanket - he’s got that more than covered.

As an added bonus to bringing this lump of love home with you, Gucci’s trainer is a package deal. Training Without Conflict trainer, Dylan Jones, has been working with him and will continue to work with him in his new home. Training sessions are completely covered to ensure his new fam gets all of the support they need for long term success.
dog.name: Gucci
